response.overview: "Cauet - Le Meilleur Of Vol. 2" brings you the absolute best and most scandalous moments from France’s legendary morning radio show host, Sébastien Cauet, and his wild crew. Packed with the iconic, unfiltered humor that defined early 2000s French pop culture, this exclusive DVD compilation captures the team's wildest studio antics, legendary hidden camera pranks, and unforgettable celebrity guest appearances. From outrageous physical challenges to hilarious behind-the-scenes footage and bonus live performances from the Olympia theater, dive into over two hours of pure, laugh-out-loud nostalgia. Experience the morning show that pushed every boundary and changed French broadcasting forever!
response.title: Cauet - Le meilleur of DVD 2
